content.short: Yield Protocol is a decentralized Ethereum platform that supports collateralized fixed-rate borrowing and lending.
content.description: Yield Protocol introduces fixed-rate borrowing and lending with fixed terms to decentralized finance. Whereas most popular DeFi protocols today rely on floating rates, which can cause interest-rate volatility, Yield Protocol provides predictable, fixed-rate agreements. By locking in terms for both loans and deposits, it helps borrowers and lenders forecast costs and returns, hedge against rate swings, and make more informed decisions. This reliability supports long-term strategies across multiple blockchains.
